scenes.title: Discovery
scenes.incoming_state: Nell expects ordinary boots; Grumble is separated from family.
scenes.turn: Nell finds a pocket storm and offers help.
scenes.outgoing_state: Grumble rests on a saucer; family deadline is known.

scenes.title: A kite carriage
scenes.incoming_state: Grumble is small but lacks high wind.
scenes.turn: Nell rigs a mitten below her kite; launch fails in still air.
scenes.outgoing_state: Grandma, Nell, kite, mitten and saucer wait for evening breeze.

scenes.title: The thirsty complication
scenes.incoming_state: Grumble waits beside tap while Nell fetches string winder.
scenes.turn: He drinks drips and becomes too heavy and large to float.
scenes.outgoing_state: Tap shut; cloud sits in wheelbarrow; Nell learns rain requires a rumble.

scenes.title: A failed private try
scenes.incoming_state: Grumble is ashamed of his squeaky thunder.
scenes.turn: Nell laughs in surprise at his try, then apologizes and listens.
scenes.outgoing_state: Trust needs repair; cloud has shed only one drop; spoon and watering can offer an idea.

scenes.title: The garden band
scenes.incoming_state: Nell offers accompaniment rather than ordering another solo.
scenes.turn: Grumble chooses the beat and invites the growing band to stay.
scenes.outgoing_state: He rumbles and rains, laughing with the dog; water starts leaving his body.

scenes.title: A traveling shower
scenes.incoming_state: Water is pooling beneath wheelbarrow beside dry plants.
scenes.turn: Nell proposes moving to the beans; Grandma wheels cloud along while band plays.
scenes.outgoing_state: Vegetables watered; Grumble is small, rain stops, and he floats to Nell’s shoulder.

scenes.title: Launch
scenes.place_time: Open grass beyond vegetable beds, sunset
scenes.incoming_state: Evening wind arrives; family nears hills.
scenes.turn: Band follows Nell; Grandma helps loosen knot; they check mitten and launch.
scenes.outgoing_state: Cloud is high enough to catch wind; Nell and Grandma control tethered kite.

scenes.title: The jump
scenes.incoming_state: Grumble hesitates on mitten thumb; Nell cannot physically support him.
scenes.turn: She restarts familiar rhythm; family answers; Grumble chooses to jump.
scenes.outgoing_state: Wind carries Grumble to his family; mitten empty, kite still tethered.

scenes.title: After the parade
scenes.incoming_state: Kite returns; Nell misses her new friend.
scenes.turn: Biscuits, damp mitten and a nighttime rhythmic greeting hold the connection.
scenes.outgoing_state: Grumble reunited with family; Nell safe at home; right boot contains tiny rainbow.
